scripts.dev: npm run build -w @marafiq/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @marafiq/shared" "npm run dev -w @marafiq/api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @marafiq/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @marafiq/shared && npm run build -w @marafiq/api && npm run build -w @marafiq/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @marafiq/shared && npm run seed -w @marafiq/api
